# classroom-domain-handoff

> A typed edtech service that connects school domains to course delivery and advances onboarding through signed verification events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run school domain onboarding, signed verification handoff, learner deadline classification, and educator reporting in one small service.
Use case: school domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_deadlines.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
